handback.summary: A label run now also does a close's autopilot work, so a close it pushed out is not lost.

criteria.853.1: The `labeled` branch in `dokima/agent_roles.py` now runs `autopilot_closed`, which closes done parents with the tree-done note.
criteria.853.2: The same `autopilot_closed` call switches every done tree off autopilot; open trees and the labeled issue stay on.
criteria.853.3: `autopilot_closed` starts unblocked issues once via `start_unblocked`; it runs after the label starts, so nothing starts twice.
